estimator: sum(x*z)/sum(x*x), x=(R-C+F)/R, z=(C_next-C_base_next)/R; no intercept; clip to bounds
training: For each origin use only transitions with target year <= min(origin,2019). Each transition base uses five consecutive observed years ending before its target. Thus the parameter is frozen throughout the 2020-2024 origins. Missing observations are never filled.
base: For each of R,C,F, take the mean of the last four annual differences. At horizon h add slope*sum(0.5**k for k=1..h) to the observed opening level. Freeze this entire base path before applying feedback.
interpretation: B is a reported budget signal, not recurring income, permanent resources, cash flow or a causal policy effect. No selective recent-year exceptional-item adjustment is allowed.
s=0 is a declared scenario convention, not Motala's actual policy or a legal requirement.
Reported result minus (R-C+F) is retained as an accounting residual. It does not alter the signal or the training cost residual. Forecast result is R_hat-C_hat+F_hat.
Eight training pairs is a locked practical minimum, not proof of identification or sufficient precision. A boundary or unidentified coefficient remains visible.
Current revised data allow retrospective evaluation only. Source publication dates and versions must be disclosed; these are not automatically real-time forecasts.
2020-2025 outcomes have already influenced project development. Earlier newly retrieved years are a separate time-ordered assessment, not evidence immune to model selection or regime change.
Leave-one-pair-out estimates describe sensitivity, not independent experiments or a confidence interval. No tuning is allowed from them.

This reduced annual diagnostic is not yet a Modelica policy mechanism. Neither technical tests nor any aggregate score alone approve the full model. Comparisons with frozen M2 on common cases remain necessary before promotion.
